tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and the side nav.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, popovers, the top bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Meter tracks, table header rows, inactive tabs, input wells.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and metric values on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥14:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, timestamps, axis labels on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (≥5.5:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox outlines, chart gridline zero-line (≥3:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Pulse teal. Primary buttons, selected nav item, the active chart series, meter fill in the healthy band.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills (≥6.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active tab ground, radar area fill.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Teal text and links on surface-raised and brand-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber. At-capacity band (85–100%) and the ‘stale’ signal. Fills and marks only, never text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for stale / at-capacity badges and callouts.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy utilization band (60–85%), done status, connected integrations.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for healthy / done badges.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ok-soft and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Under-utilized band (<60%), in-progress status, neutral informational notes.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for under-utilized / in-progress badges.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on info-soft and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Over-utilized band (100–120%). Always paired with the word ‘Over’.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for over-utilized badges.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warn-soft and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Critical: >120% utilization, overdue tasks, broken integration sync.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for overdue / critical badges.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft and on surface-raised.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element (≥3:1 on all surfaces).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on the dashboard only.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-titles inside cards, table group rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 4 tasks have not been updated in 2+ working days.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Metric labels above values; always uppercase.

styles.name: tabular
styles.usage: Issue keys, hours, dates in tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge dot gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, meter height.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutter between cards, table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing, page side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of page, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Meter tracks, checkboxes, table chips, heatmap cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, integration tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, avatars, filter chips.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns and the task drawer only. Cards use a border, not a shadow.
